assets.caption: Form G - Deflection calculation worksheet (Calc. No. 5-G). The M.W. Kellogg Co., Piping Flexibility and Stress Analysis, dated 5-7-50. Tabulates summations of shape coefficients with moment/force columns (F_XA, F_XB, F_XC, F_XD, M_ZC, F_YC, F_YD) and constants used to compute deflections at successive points along the pipe line.

Form F-1 - Comprehensive shape coefficient and stress calculation worksheet (Calc. No. 5-F). The M.W. Kellogg Co., Piping Flexibility and Stress Analysis - Moments and Stresses, dated 5-7-50. Columns are points 0' through 7; rows include conversion-to-coefficient rules, coordinate values (z', x', y'), shape coefficient sums, stress components (S_x, S_y', S_z'), V-vector terms, deflection deltas, and W^2 dimensions based on hot modulus E_h. Header note: Pipe size 5", E_h(15) = 16.0 x 10^6.
